versions.short: The bill would rename the Chiricahua National Monument in Arizona as Chiricahua National Park, keeping the same boundaries and having the Secretary of the Interior manage it under the existing proclamations and the general laws for national park units. It would also require the Secretary to protect traditional cultural and religious sites in the park, consult with Indian Tribes on that protection, give tribal members access to those sites for traditional uses, and allow temporary closures of specific areas to the public at a tribe's request, limited to the smallest practical area and shortest necessary time.
